description: This file defines a test scenario class 'Scenario4MultipleSubjects18' which implements 'Scenario4MultipleSubjects'. It sets up a specific authorization scenario involving subjects, permissions, and resource paths to test policy enforcement behavior using a `PolicyAlgorithm`. The class uses annotations from JMH for benchmarking scope and constructs a scenario setup with specific permission statements and checks.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects18
classes.description: A test scenario class representing specific permission scenarios for multiple subjects, implementing 'Scenario4MultipleSubjects'. It initializes a setup with predefined resource permissions and provides access to this setup and a policy application function.
